name: Flight Simulator: Airplane Adventure
summary: Take the controls in Flight Simulator: Airplane Adventure, a physics-based VR flight simulator built around hands-on cockpit flying. Start the engine, manage throttle and aircraft controls, take off from the runway, fly different airplanes, explore diverse environments, and master smooth, precise landings across varied terrain. Progress through Career missions, enjoy Free Flight exploration, or sharpen your pilot skills in landing, checkpoint, time trial, low-altitude, and aerobatic challenges.
